info.title: Timely API
info.description: API specification for Timely scheduling webapp

post.description: Create a new user account with username, email, and password

400.description: Validation error - username may already exist or fields invalid

post.description: Authenticate user and receive authentication token
Logout user from all authenticated sessions

204.description: Successfully logged out from all sessions

get.description: Test that authentication token is valid
Retrieve a list of tasks for the authenticated user with optional filtering and sorting

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Sort by field (importance, deadline, estimated_minutes, start_time). Prefix with '-' for descending

post.description: Create a new task for the authenticated user

get.description: Get details of a specific task

put.description: Update all fields of a specific task

patch.description: Update specific fields of a task

get.description: Retrieve a list of events for the authenticated user

post.description: Create a new event for the authenticated user with optional reminders

get.description: Get details of a specific event

put.description: Update all fields of a specific event

patch.description: Update specific fields of an event

get.description: Retrieve a list of all available categories (public endpoint)
Get details of a specific category
Retrieve a list of grades for the authenticated user, sorted by most recent achievement date

post.description: Create a new grade record for the authenticated user

get.description: Get details of a specific grade

put.description: Update all fields of a specific grade

patch.description: Update specific fields of a grade

get.description: Retrieve preferences for the authenticated user

post.description: Create preference settings for the authenticated user. Users can only have one preference record.

400.description: Validation error or user already has a preference

get.description: Get details of specific preference record

put.description: Update all fields of user preferences

patch.description: Update specific fields of user preferences

minutes_before.description: Minutes before event to trigger reminder

time_spent_minutes.description: Total time spent on related tasks in minutes (read-only)

days_off.description: List of day IDs representing days off (1=Monday, 7=Sunday)
List of day IDs representing days off (1=Monday, 7=Sunday)

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Task management endpoints (CRUD operations for tasks and calendar items)

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Event management endpoints (CRUD operations for events with reminders and recurrence)

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Category management endpoints (read-only for public, full CRUD for authenticated users)

tags.name: Grades
tags.description: Grade management endpoints (CRUD operations for assessment grades)

tags.name: Preferences
tags.description: User preference management endpoints (sleep times, days off). Users can only have one preference record.
